where: Da Gobshot Thunderbuss on the Warboss in Mega Armour datasheet row
why: Answer: list-entry only. GW’s Warboss in Mega Armour datasheet has no such weapon ("This model is equipped with: 1 Big Shoota; 1 ’Uge Choppa.", no wargear options; orks_Warboss-In-Mega-Armour.html); the profile is the enhancement’s (orks.txt l.557-575). The resolver’s own model (verify/tables.js: "a row the datasheet does not have (an enhancement’s ability) is the list’s own") puts list-caused facts on the entry with their reason; DATASHEETS rows should be GW’s datasheet. It is not only a principle: the resolver also says "An entry without its rows takes all of the datasheet’s", so a later Warboss in Mega Armour entry without its own ranged rows (hand-written, or an importer path that omits them) would show the Gobshot. Fix: remove Da Gobshot Thunderbuss from DATASHEETS orks/warboss-in-mega-armour.ranged; give the entry the full row { name:"Da Gobshot Thunderbuss", who:"Warboss in Mega Armour", range:"24\"", A:"6", BS:"4+", S:"7", AP:"-2", D:"2", kw:["LETHAL HITS: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE","RAPID FIRE 6"], enh:true } (its reason: the enhancement), and let from-json.js/tables.js check it against the enhancement text instead of the datasheet. Display unchanged.
